purpose: Ingest authoritative security sources discovered during the first post-coverage multiplicity pass and formalize revisable-NO_HIT behavior as part of the empirical collision model, while preserving all CVE matches as M1 rather than physical Glob evidence.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, dataset, advisory, standard, method, software resource, operational precedent, commercial signal or information item receives a Worldshepherd use when it materially improves any capability, or an explicit negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: NVD, vendor advisories, GitHub security advisories and distro/vendor mirrors describing the same vulnerability are provenance aliases and are not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: CVE identifiers and other security namespace matches can substantially improve Worldshepherd hardening while carrying zero automatic Glob evidence; they remain M1 unless the target independently matches a verified physical quantity.

sources.title: CVE-2024-24577 — libgit2 git_index_add heap corruption
sources.note: Use freed-entry/heap-corruption failure mode and fixed-version boundaries as a Git-library/input-validation hardening reference. 24577 is the CVE identifier.

sources.title: CVE-2023-39532 — Endo SES compartment confinement escape
sources.note: Use as a capability-sandbox escape precedent: syntactic paths to dynamic import can defeat assumptions that guest code has no host capabilities. 39532 is the CVE identifier.

sources.title: CVE-2024-39532 — Junos sensitive information written to logs
sources.note: Use as an audit/logging confidentiality case: observability data must not capture secrets in plaintext. 39532 is the CVE identifier.

sources.title: CVE-2026-45779 — OpenXDMoD unauthenticated SQL injection
sources.note: Use as a direct database/API input-validation case for metrics and analytics platforms; versions before 10.0.3 are affected. 45779 is the CVE identifier.

sources.title: CVE-2025-47275 — Auth0-PHP CookieStore authentication-tag weakness
sources.note: Use as a session-state cryptography/key-rotation case; fixed in Auth0-PHP 8.14.0 and prior cookies should be invalidated after remediation. 47275 is the CVE identifier.

sources.title: CVE-2026-49401 — Deno macOS Unicode path-equivalence permission bypass
sources.note: Use as a path-canonicalization control: bytewise permission checks can diverge from filesystem equivalence semantics. Fixed in Deno 2.7.14. 49401 is the CVE identifier.

sources.title: CVE-2024-53242 — Siemens Teamcenter/Tecnomatix WRL parser out-of-bounds read
sources.note: Use as a digital-engineering file-ingestion hardening case because malformed WRL geometry files can cross from design data into code execution. 53242 is the CVE identifier.

sources.title: CVE-2025-57796 — Explorance Blue hardcoded reversible encryption key
sources.note: Use as a secret-storage anti-pattern: sensitive passwords/configuration encrypted with a static recoverable key remain decryptable offline. Fixed in 8.14.12. 57796 is the CVE identifier.

sources.title: CVE-2026-63999 — Linux ethtool RSS allocation leak on get_rxfh failure
sources.note: Use as an error-path resource-release regression case in networking code. 63999 is the CVE identifier.

information_updates.finding: Post-coverage scanning converted multiple prior defined-pass NO_HIT states into authoritative CVE-bearing states. The append-only design correctly preserves both observations: earlier search failure and later discovery, enabling measurement of query/source coverage rather than rewriting history.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Later metadata discovery changes collision-density estimates only; it does not alter physical Glob evidence.

information_updates.finding: The new security corpus adds distinct trust-boundary classes: memory ownership/lifetime, guest-code capability confinement, log redaction, SQL/API input handling, session cryptography/key rotation, Unicode/path canonicalization, design-file parsing, secret storage and error-path resource cleanup.
information_updates.claims_boundary: This taxonomy is a Worldshepherd engineering synthesis, not a numerical relation among CVE IDs.

Cross-reference the trust-boundary taxonomy against the actual Worldshepherd dependency/runtime inventory before turning generic CVE lessons into concrete patch requirements.
Continue same-system topology and relational verification independently for physical P1/P2 candidates, especially W II and Sr I.
